glosses: equipped with, or involving the use of, weapons

examples.text: Tom estava armado com um facão.
examples.en: Tom was armed with a machete.

examples.text: Os soldados estão armados e prontos.
examples.en: The soldiers are armed and ready.

examples.text: Tom estava armado com uma faca de cozinha.
examples.en: Tom was armed with a kitchen knife.
